title: Charles Nessler at the Schwarzkopf Institute for Hair Hygiene in Berlin
source: Das Haar. Blätter für Schwarzkopf-Haarpflege [Leaves for Schwarzkopf Hair Care], house publication of Hans Schwarzkopf, Berlin-Tempelhof, vol. 5, no. 3, cover page, March 1939. Source held as a privately preserved scan.
description: Cover page featuring a photograph of Charles Nessler during his visit to the Schwarzkopf Institute for Hair Hygiene in Berlin. The caption identifies him as the inventor of the permanent wave. The issue also refers to the hairdressing supplies exhibition at Zoo Berlin, held from 26 to 28 March 1939. The source documents Nessler's professional recognition late in his career. A handwritten marginal note is present but has not been fully deciphered. Document type: company magazine / house publication.
original_title: Charles Nessler im Schwarzkopf-Institut für Haarhygiene in Berlin

title: Société Gallia – Historical Product Catalogue
source: Société Gallia, Félix Boudou & Cie, Paris, 8 rue Notre-Dame-de-Lorette (9th arrondissement). Catalogue cover; digitised collection of the City of Paris specialised libraries, ARK pf0002154404. Publication date not independently verified.
description: French-language catalogue cover for Société Gallia (Félix Boudou & Cie), featuring a stylised hairstyle illustration, the GALLIA brand and the slogan 'La Marque de la Qualité' ('The Mark of Quality'). The cover identifies the company's address at 8 rue Notre-Dame-de-Lorette, Paris. The publication date has not yet been verified from the catalogue record.
